specification.postconditions:
(a + b ≤ c ∨ a + c ≤ b ∨ b + c ≤ a → result = -1) ∧
  (¬ (a + b ≤ c ∨ a + c ≤ b ∨ b + c ≤ a) →
    result ≥ 0 ∧ (result * 100).den = 1 ∧ (result < 1 / 200 ∨ (result - 1 / 200) ^ 2 ≤ area2 a b c) ∧
      area2 a b c ≤ (result + 1 / 200) ^ 2)

metadata.note: the area is the root of a rational, so the postcondition says that the result is a multiple of 1/100 within 1/200 of it
